data.name: Death's Shot
data.description: When the bolt ace scores a critical hit, she can spend 1 grit point to deal normal damage, and the target must succeed at a Fortitude saving throw with a DC equal to 10 + 1/2 the bolt ace's level + the bolt ace's Dexterity modifier. On a failed saving throw, the target dies. This is a death attack. Performing this deed does not allow the bolt ace to regain grit from confirming a critical hit or making a killing blow.
